profile.name: SQLite CAN消息记录器
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于将接收到的CAN总线消息缓冲后异步写入SQLite数据库，并在需要时从数据库中读取历史消息，适合实验中的总线数据记录、追溯与离线分析。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that buffers received CAN bus messages and writes them asynchronously to an SQLite database, and can also read back recorded messages for experiment data logging, traceability, and offline analysis.

registry.name: Sqlite Writer
registry.description: Sqlite Writer是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot等操作。
